title: Grateful Dead Live at Recreation Hall, UC Davis on 1982-03-14
lineage: Dat Sony PCM-R500 > Tascam DA-3000 > Samplitude Pro X3 Suite > FLAC/44.1k  1 DVD FLAC Transfer By Charlie Miller

ai_review.summary: Average soundboard capture of a restrained show – the setlist looks good on paper but jams are minimal and the recording isn’t top‑tier.
ai_review.review: The soundboard source is complete but not particularly crisp, with listeners noting that an audience mix sounds better. Musically the concert feels low on improvisation; the second‑set list promised excitement yet the band never really “goes crazy,” aside from a brief Happy Birthday tease for Phil during space.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one moderate (3‑star) review; comments balance modest praise for the full set with criticism of both recording clarity and limited jam content, leading to an overall average rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers say the board isn’t the best—some muddiness and lack of sparkle; a listener prefers the audience version for clarity.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Second‑set looks promising on paper but never erupts into extended jams; overall flow feels restrained.

band_member_comments.Phil: Space includes a brief Happy Birthday tease for Phil (born March 15, 1940).
